response.text:
CL4SRec crops a randomly located contiguous subsequence of length floor(ηL); masking and local reordering provide alternative views. Two augmented views share one encoder, trained with next-item loss plus weighted contrastive loss. Its augmentation-only ablation, SASRec_aug, improves crop HR@20 from 0.0541 to 0.0546 on Sports and 0.0529 to 0.0576 on Yelp; adding contrastive learning improves further. However, the reported ablation does not document matching target frequencies, supervised positions, negative draws, loss denominators and optimizer updates. It establishes cropping precedent, not a fully controlled context-only comparison. [Original paper, §§3.3–3.5, 4.5](https://arxiv.org/html/2010.14395)

Recommended experimental control: generate an identical ordered stream of training (user, target-position) pairs for both conditions, preserving every target’s multiplicity. Compare the available full prefix against a randomly shortened suffix ending immediately before that same target. This preserves next-item adjacency; an arbitrary interior crop with the original terminal label changes the prediction gap. For dense supervision, match the exact original target positions and their weights; use separate prefix examples where necessary. Reuse identical negative item IDs, sampled with the same exclusion policy from original training histories, and separate augmentation RNG from sampling RNG.

Normalize both losses over the same supervised examples, excluding padding; average multiple context views per target before averaging targets. Match initialization, optimizer, learning-rate schedule by update count, batch composition, accumulation and total optimizer steps—here seed 42, 200 batches/epoch, at most 200 epochs. Include fixed-length recent-history truncation to distinguish randomization from shorter context. For NextItNet, retain the causal convolution backbone and final nonpadding readout; crops beyond its receptive field may have no effect. Assessment: basic cropping has limited novelty and low implementation difficulty; rigorously matched dense supervision is the more demanding contribution.
